title: Rapid Response of Stem Cells and Immune Cells for Efficacy
official: Rapid Response of Stem Cells and Immune Cells for Efficacy: An Acute Randomized Double-blind Placebo-controlled Cross-over Trial
summary: The goal for this clinical trial is to compare rapid effects of four products on stem cells, immune activation, and mitochondrial function. A double-blind, placebo-controlled, cross-over study design will be used.
